answer: Under auction-scarcity cohort bidding, each epoch the jade river network admits only F identities: applicants submit escalating sealed bids, the top-F distinct bidders win slots, and every losing bid above the Fth price is permanently burned, creating a visible ripple in total destroyed value. Flooding with N fake agents forces the attacker to outbid F honest bidders repeatedly; if the marginal price doubles each epoch (10, 20, 40 credits), N fakes cost roughly N×2^N nonlinearly, so 8 fakes cost over 5,000 credits while honest agents pay only the clearing price once, a far smaller outlay.
